pad.toward: (async()=>{const S=await import('/state/index.ts'); const M=await import('/engine2d/landModel.ts'); const land=await window.__e2e.shared('land'); const c=S.useLandStore.getState().chunks['0,0']; const npc=c.scene.npcs.find(p=>p.id==='aya'); const at=[0*32+npc.x+0.5, 0*32+npc.z+0.5]; const active=S.useSessionStore.getState().activeInstance; const graph=S.useWorldStore.getState().scene.value; const seed=land.landSeedOf(active.instance.save); const chunks=S.useLandStore.getState().chunks; const others=[]; for (const [key, ch] of Object.entries(chunks)) { if (ch.status!=='written') continue; const [cx,cz]=key.split(',').map(Number); for (const n of ch.scene.npcs) { const p=[cx*32+n.x+0.5, cz*32+n.z+0.5]; if (Math.hypot(p[0]-at[0],p[1]-at[1])>0.01) others.push(p); } } const spots=[]; for (const r of [0.8,1.2]) for (let i=0;i<16;i++){ const a=i/16*Math.PI*2; const p=[at[0]+Math.cos(a)*r, at[1]+Math.sin(a)*r]; if(!M.canStandAt(graph, seed, chunks, p[0], p[1], null)) continue; const near=Math.min(99,...others.map(o=>Math.hypot(o[0]-p[0],o[1]-p[1]))); if (near<=r+0.3) continue; spots.push(p);} return spots[0] ?? at; })()
